content:
CLEVELAND, Aug. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Parker Hannifin Corporation (NYSE: PH), the global leader in motion and control technologies, today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $2.00 per share of common stock to shareholders of record as of August 31, 2026. The dividend is payable September 11, 2026.

This is the company's 305th consecutive quarterly dividend. Parker has increased its annual dividends per share paid to shareholders for 70 consecutive fiscal years, among the top five longest-running dividend-increase records in the S&P 500 Index.

Parker Hannifin is a Fortune 250 global leader in motion and control technologies. For more than a century the company has been enabling engineering breakthroughs that lead to a better tomorrow. Learn more at www.parker.com or @parkerhannifin.

chineseContent:
克利夫兰，2026 年 8 月 20 日（环球通讯社）——运动和控制技术领域的全球领导者派克汉尼汾公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：PH）今天宣布，其董事会已宣布向截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日登记在册的股东派发每股普通股 2.00 美元的定期季度现金股息。该股息将于 2026 年 9 月 11 日支付。

这是该公司连续第305次季度派息。 Parker 已连续 70 个财年增加向股东支付的每股年度股息，位列标准普尔 500 指数中股息增加时间最长的前五名。

Parker Hannifin 是财富 250 强运动和控制技术领域的全球领导者。一个多世纪以来，该公司一直致力于实现工程突破，从而创造更美好的明天。了解更多信息，请访问 www.parker.com 或@parkerhannifin。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
